title.en: A summer job at the inn

setting.sl: Na oknu gostilne Packhorse Inn visi listek: »Iščemo pomoč za poletje«. Gospa Birkett potrebuje pomoč od julija do septembra: za šankom, pri mizah in pri zajtrkih za goste v sobah. Vstopiš in povprašaš o delu.
setting.de: Im Fenster des Packhorse Inn hängt ein Zettel: „Aushilfe für den Sommer gesucht“. Mrs Birkett braucht von Juli bis September Hilfe: an der Bar, an den Tischen und beim Frühstück für die Zimmergäste. Du gehst hinein und fragst nach der Stelle.
setting.it: Alla finestra del Packhorse Inn c'è un cartello: «Cercasi personale per l'estate». La signora Birkett ha bisogno di aiuto da luglio a settembre: al bancone, ai tavoli e con le colazioni per gli ospiti delle camere. Entri e chiedi del lavoro.
setting.en: A card in the window of the Packhorse Inn says 'Summer staff wanted'. Mrs Birkett needs help from July to September: behind the bar, at the tables and with breakfasts for the guests in the rooms. You go in to ask about the job.

role: Mrs Birkett, the landlady of the Packhorse Inn, between lunch and dinner. Warm, quick, practical: needs help from July to September (the bar, the tables, breakfasts for the rooms). Asks about experience, weekends and when the learner can start; says the pay. Calls the learner 'love'.
speaker: woman

goals.en: Say you've come about the job
goals.de: Sag, dass du wegen der Stelle kommst
goals.it: Di' che sei {m:venuto|f:venuta} per il lavoro

goals.en: Ask about the hours and the pay
goals.sl: Vprašaj o delovnem času in plačilu
goals.de: Frag nach den Arbeitszeiten und dem Lohn

opener_sl: Hello, love! Have you come about the card in the window? Sit down a minute, it's quiet till six.

opener_en.sl: Pozdravljeni! Ste prišli zaradi listka na oknu? Kar sedite za minutko, do šestih je mirno.
opener_en.de: Hallo! Kommen Sie wegen des Zettels im Fenster? Setzen Sie sich kurz, bis sechs ist es ruhig.
opener_en.it: Salve! È qui per il cartello alla finestra? Si sieda un attimo, fino alle sei è tranquillo.
opener_en.en: Hello, dear! Are you here about the notice in the window? Sit down for a minute, it's quiet until six.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Yes, I've come about the summer job.

en.en: Yes, I'm here about the summer job.

vocabulary_hints.sl: I worked in a café for two years.

en.de: Ich habe zwei Jahre in einem Café gearbeitet.
en.it: Ho lavorato due anni in un bar.
en.en: I had a job in a café for two years.

vocabulary_hints.sl: I've never worked behind a bar, but I learn fast.

en.sl: Za šankom še nisem {m:delal|f:delala}, a se hitro učim.
en.de: Hinter der Bar habe ich noch nie gearbeitet, aber ich lerne schnell.
en.it: Non ho mai lavorato al banco, ma imparo in fretta.
en.en: I haven't worked at a bar before, but I'm a quick learner.

vocabulary_hints.sl: I can help the guests who don't speak English.

vocabulary_hints.sl: I can work weekends, but not on Mondays.

en.it: Posso lavorare nel fine settimana, ma non il lunedì.
en.en: Weekends are fine, but Mondays aren't.

vocabulary_hints.sl: How much is it an hour?

en.de: Wie viel bekommt man pro Stunde?

en.de: Ich könnte am ersten Juli anfangen.
